title: Folders
name: Folder name
description: Real directories shared with your Bot, with optional sessions and permissions.
movedToTrash: Moved to Trash. Restore it from Trash in the Resources toolbar.
trashHint: Folders and their contents stay here until permanently deleted. Restore them to Resources to use them again.
permanentDeleteHint: The folder, all its files, associated learning records, and folder conversations will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
noProjects: No projects yet. Create one below.
projectHint: A project groups resources in a folder; a course is one study resource. New projects create a resource folder named “项目：project name”.
selectionHint: Drag empty space to select · Ctrl/Cmd-click to add
removeHint: Remove the real file or empty directory. Learning records and sessions are retained; deleted files are not recreated.
pathHint: The directory ID is permanent. Renaming never changes its path.
instructionsHint: Used by new tasks in this folder. Save shared knowledge directly as files.
sessionDeleteHint: Delete this session and its messages. Files are retained. Stop unfinished tasks first.
folderEmpty: This folder is empty. Upload files, create a file, or authorize a Bot to work here.
projectOnly: This session uses only this folder's files and permissions.
noAgent: Authorize a BOT in folder settings to start chatting.
readOnly: This folder is archived. You can view history and download files.
grantHint: Access changes stop unfinished tasks in this folder. Manage access lets the BOT rename this folder from its own chat.
policyHint: Global settings also limit effective permissions. Commands mount only this folder's directory. External MCP is not yet available in folder sessions.
serverRequired: Real directories require an authenticated backend connection.

errors.project_trashed: This folder is in Trash. Restore it first.
errors.protected_resource_folder: This workspace is used by the system and cannot be deleted.
errors.project_busy: The target folder is still in use by an unfinished operation. Try again later.
errors.thread_busy: Stop this session's tasks before deleting it.
errors.project_access_denied: This BOT does not have the required folder access.
errors.project_not_found: Folder not found or access denied.
errors.project_file_not_found: File not found. Refresh the directory.
errors.project_file_conflict: The file changed. Reopen it before editing or deleting.
errors.project_file_exists: A file with this name already exists. Choose another name.
errors.project_directory_not_empty: Empty the directory before deleting it.
errors.project_path_denied: Links, special files, and paths outside the folder are not accessible.
errors.invalid_project_path: Use a valid name without parent segments or special characters.
errors.invalid_resource_folder: Invalid folder hierarchy. Top-level permission scopes cannot be nested inside another folder.
errors.project_text_too_large: This file exceeds the text editor limit (1 MiB). Download it to view.
errors.project_file_not_text: This is not a text file. Download it to view.
errors.file_too_large_or_invalid: The upload exceeds the server limit or was incomplete.
errors.invalid_project_name: Enter a folder name of 1–100 characters.
errors.agent_name_taken: This BOT name is already in use.
